d:
From challenging snake rescues to chaotic animal-catching attempts, Turtleman and Neal must rely on quick thinking and plenty of patience to handle each situation. With wild creatures refusing to cooperate and every mission bringing a fresh surprise, can they bring these encounters under control before things get even wilder?
Watch Call of the Wildman, Season 3, Episodes 14, 2, 18 and 9; Season 1, Episodes 14, 22, 5 and 29, on Animal Planet India.
